name: Coral Licorice Root
headline: Coral Licorice Root
description: Licorice root extract with ginger root extract has a soothing effect on the respiratory tract and the digestive system and helps strengthen the body's defences.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule twice a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Deglycyrrhizinated licorice root extract, licorice root extract, ginger root extract, excipients.
